name: Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra
title: Co-Founder & Hon'ble Chancellor, Shobhit University
institutions: Shobhit Institute of Engineering & Technology (Deemed to-be-University, Meerut)
biography: Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra is a distinguished Indian educationist, philanthropist, and social reformer. As the Chancellor of Shobhit University and Chairman of NICE Society, he has dedicated over three decades to transforming higher education in India. Born with a deep commitment to societal development, he championed the democratization of technical, biological, and medical education in rural and semi-urban India, creating world-class opportunities for thousands of first-generation learners.

core_pillars.title: Empowering Nation Through Education
core_pillars.description: Firm belief that accessible, value-based education is the primary driver of national prosperity and individual empowerment.

core_pillars.title: Convergence of Ancient Wisdom & Modern Technology
core_pillars.description: Pioneering the synergy between traditional Indian sciences (Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Yogic sciences) and cutting-edge technologies (Biotechnology, Artificial Intelligence, Agricultural Informatics).

core_pillars.title: Rural Youth Empowerment & Affordable Healthcare
core_pillars.description: Establishing premier institutions and a 100-bed charitable Ayurvedic research hospital in rural Western UP to serve underprivileged communities.

core_pillars.title: Global Goodwill & Academic Diplomacy
core_pillars.description: Fostering international academic collaborations, youth forums with UN/UNESCO, and representing Indian higher education globally.

leadership_roles: Chairman, National Institute of Computer Education (NICE) Society
Chairman, ASSOCHAM National Council on Education
Advisor & Patron to numerous educational trusts and social welfare bodies in India and abroad
quotes: Education must not merely prepare students for a living; it must prepare them for life, grounding them in ethics, compassion, and innovation.
True nation-building happens when world-class knowledge reaches the doorsteps of rural youth.
Ancient Indian wisdom and modern technology are not conflicting paths; they are two wings of the same bird of progress.

milestones.title: Founding of NICE Society
milestones.summary: Pioneered community computer literacy and vocational training across North India.
milestones.narrative: In 1989, recognizing the imminent digital revolution, Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra founded the National Institute of Computer Education (NICE) Society. The initiative democratized computer literacy at a time when technology education was restricted to metropolitan centers.

milestones.title: Establishment of SIET Meerut
milestones.summary: Established Shobhit Institute of Engineering & Technology, Meerut.
milestones.narrative: To bridge the critical gap in technical and engineering talent in Uttar Pradesh, Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra established SIET in Meerut, featuring state-of-the-art laboratories in computer engineering, electronics, and biomedical disciplines.

milestones.title: Conferred Deemed-to-be-University Status
milestones.summary: Recognized by Government of India Ministry of HRD under Section 3 of UGC Act.
milestones.narrative: In recognition of outstanding academic standards, research in biotechnology, and state-of-the-art infrastructure, the Central Government conferred Deemed-to-be-University status upon SIET Meerut, establishing Shobhit University.

milestones.title: Establishment of Shobhit University, Gangoh
milestones.summary: Founded second university campus in rural Gangoh, Saharanpur.
milestones.narrative: Demonstrating unyielding commitment to rural youth upliftment, Chancellor Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra established Shobhit University at Gangoh under Uttar Pradesh State Act No. 3 of 2012, bringing world-class higher education to rural western UP.

milestones.title: Shobhit Ayurvedic Medical College & Hospital
milestones.summary: Inauguration of a 100-bed hospital and research center for traditional medicine.
milestones.narrative: Driven by his philosophy of holistic healthcare, he established Shobhit Ayurvedic Medical College & Hospital in Gangoh, combining ancient Ayurvedic healing with modern diagnostic facilities and providing heavily subsidized healthcare to rural families.

milestones.title: Chairman of ASSOCHAM National Education Council
milestones.summary: Leading national dialogue on higher education policy reforms and industry integration.
milestones.narrative: Appointed as Chairman of ASSOCHAM's National Council on Education, Chancellor Vijendra represented Indian universities at apex policy forums, championing industry-academia synergy, skill-based curricula, and equitable access for student innovators.

milestones.title: AI & Biotechnology Centers of Excellence
milestones.summary: Advanced research centers launched in bioinformatics, AI, and smart agriculture.
milestones.narrative: Inaugurated dedicated research clusters at Shobhit University focused on applying Artificial Intelligence and genomics to solve regional agricultural and environmental challenges.
